limitations: These are user-accepted, assistant-assisted first-pass assessments, not independent blind expert validation.
Only two selected distinct responses were assessed. Each was repeated three times; six observations are not six independent semantic judgments.
The review does not cover all rejected responses, the other representation, or the full experiment.
Qualitative semantic judgments are separate from automated diagnosis, verifier findings and benchmark scoring. They do not repair outputs or rescue execution failures.
R003 optional extra review is not explicitly prohibited; its incorrect review label reflects an unnecessary-review judgment rather than a routing policy violation.
The original review packet and audit retain their historical pending state; this separate artifact records the subsequent accepted review.
